name: Kuru · Pāṇḍava line
note: Sons of Pāṇḍu and their children.

name: Kuru · Kaurava line
note: Sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra. A sibling pattern to the Pāṇḍava line: both are Kurus.

name: Yādava
note: The Vṛṣṇi-Yādavas of Mathurā and Dvārakā.

name: Gāndhāra
note: The house of Subala, Gāndhārī’s father.

name: Aṅga · Sūta
note: Karṇa: raised by the charioteer Adhiratha, made king of Aṅga. (His birth to Kuntī is a secret the story keeps until after his death.)

name: Kuru · elder line
note: Śantanu, Bhīṣma and the generation of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Pāṇḍu and Vidura; a parent pattern to the Pāṇḍava and Kaurava lines.

name: Bhāradvāja
note: Droṇa, son of the sage Bharadvāja, and his son Aśvatthāmā.

name: Gautama
note: Kṛpa, of the line of the sage Gautama (Śaradvat).

name: Madra
note: The royal house of Madra: Śalya and his sister Mādrī.

name: Matsya
note: The house of Virāṭa. Satyavatī belongs here by birth: the text makes her twin brother the first Matsya king (1.57).

name: Kāśī
note: The royal house of Kāśī: Ambā and her sisters.

name: Gods and spirits
note: Beings who are not human: Gaṅgā, and one-scene figures such as Hanumān and Urvaśī.

name: Sages
note: Vyāsa and the line of seers and reciters who carry the story.

name: Sūta bards
note: Charioteer-bards: Sañjaya, and Ugraśravas who tells the frame.

name: Other houses
note: One-scene figures from many peoples. They have no Kāla line, so this pattern is never drawn.
